build_note: Installed from the pinned pure-Python py3-none-any wheel by hash; the image checks that the wheel's json5/ package is byte-identical to the pinned sdist and that json5/parser.py, json5/lib.py and LICENSE match recorded SHA-256 values. No runtime dependencies.
parser_family: json5 (dpranke/pyjson5) pure-Python PEG parser generated by glop 0.9.0 (json5/parser.py) with AST-to-value conversion in json5/lib.py; independent of the CPython json, simplejson, UltraJSON, Jiter, orjson/yyjson, YAJL, msgspec, RapidJSON and simdjson families in this cell
api: json5.loads(local JSON bytes); json5.loads(decoded str) and json5.load(local binary stream) are checked against the same oracle
fuzz_engine: external one-file Python bridge for AFL++ and generator replay
coverage: Python line tracing of json5 package source (parser.py and lib.py) during valid-control replay
scope: JSON structure and values from local bytes via json5.loads; valid nested object and nested array controls only, each matching an exact type-tagged CPython json oracle tree. json5 accepts the JSON5 superset (comments, unquoted keys, trailing commas, single-quoted strings, hexadecimal numbers, Infinity/NaN), so it does not reject non-RFC 8259 input.
